notes: Eenmanszaak run by instructor Ronald Heinsman; small one-person school. Specialises in personal/calm guidance for students with faalangst (test anxiety) and autism spectrum disorder (ASS); also offers 2todrive, spoedopleiding and opfriscursus. Teaches via the CBR RIS-method. Offers only category B (car); aggregators show no automaat tag and no explicit automaat/schakel statement, so transmission left unknown (likely manual default but unconfirmed). Founding: KvK registration date 01-10-2014 is authoritative (founding_year 2014). Conflicting secondary signals: rijloket says 'Sinds 2017', clickdrive '12 jaar ervaring', rijschool-tips '11 jaar' — all inconsistent with each other and with KvK, so KvK used. CBR last-12-months exams ~37 with ~54-55% pass rate per aggregators; recent CBR window (Apr 2025-Mar 2026) shows weaker first-time pass (~37-39%).
